description: Work was done on this request
Fixed, but not by this request: already serviced or resolved by an earlier one
Duplicate of another request; the outcome lives on the original
The crew found nothing to fix (may be legitimate, such as an item not put out)
Handed off to another agency or outside the City's scope
Closed with the work still pending
Could not be done: no access, can't locate the address, incomplete information
Cancelled by the customer, a contractor or the department
Information was provided; not a service outcome
Closed without saying how: a generic code, or no code at all
